description: Keep incredibly warm this winter by wearing our Polar Fleece Watch Cap. These military winter hats offer unbeatable all-weather protection, provide additional coverage against the snow, are built to withstand rugged outdoor use, and will protect you wherever you go. They’re great for daily wear, camping, fishing, hiking, skiing, snowboarding, skating, biking, and other outdoor activities. Keep one in your car for those spontaneous adventures that your friends or family came up with on the fly! Optimal Warmth: The military-styled watch cap features lightweight and breathable polar fleece fabric that offers enhanced warmth and protection, creating a helpful and convenient barrier against cold weather. Comfortable Fit: In addition to keeping you warm, the soft beanie hat is extremely comfortable. Wear your winter cap all day (and night) without any discomfort. One Size Fits Most: Our comfortable outdoor hats are for both men and women, and will accommodate most head sizes. The fleece material aids in its unmatched versatility, and is designed to cover the ears for added warmth. We’ve Got You Covered: Looking for additional winter accessories? Stay warm and dry with one of our Wool Scarves, a pair of our Fingerless Wool Gloves, or a pair of 8 Inch Extreme Cold Weather Hiking Boots that feature Rothco’s Thermoblock Tech insulation.
